entry.title: New: BILL004(25) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO SPONSORSHIPS.

Reestablishes a process to obtain sponsorships for city facilities, parks, programs, equipment, and tangible property. Includes guidelines and procedures to optimize the program for revenue generation.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
